exposure: Attendance of a childbirth preparation course
outcome: Exclusive breastfeeding status during the first year of life
Maintenance of exclusive breastfeeding up to 6 months
cohort: The study participants were cohorts of children born in Trentino, Italy, between 2009 and 2013.
finding: The study found that 83.5% of infants were exclusively breastfed at hospital discharge, decreasing to 34.7% by 6 months, and that exclusive breastfeeding duration was significantly influenced by maternal citizenship, area of residence, education level, parity, infant passive smoke exposure, and attendance of a childbirth preparation course.
